newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Handelsbanken benefits from bond change.
newsitem.headline: Handelsbanken benefits from bond change.

text.p: Sweden's Handelsbanken said on Tuesday that a restructuring of its bond portfolio improved 1996 results by 621 million crowns.
"Parts of the bond portfolio have been reclassified as a financial current asset," the bank said in a statement. "These securities have been sold in January, 1997."
Previously, the parts were classified as fixed financial assets.
"The restructuring means we can include the value change in our earnings," a Handelsbanken spokesman told Reuters.

The move was part of Handelsbanken's preparations for acquiring Swedish mortgage lender Stadshypotek, the bank said. On Monday, Handelsbanken said its 22.9 billion crown bid on Stadshypotek was successful.

The bond portfolio change means Swedish banks' results are more easily compared as other banks classified their investment portfolios as financial current assets at the beginning of 1996, the bank said.
